product_launch.name: Finalize launch brief
product_launch.description: Confirm offer, audience, goals, core message, budget, and success metrics.

product_launch.name: Approve launch timeline
product_launch.description: Review milestones, owners, dependencies, and launch-day responsibilities.

product_launch.name: Write landing page copy
product_launch.description: Draft hero, value props, proof points, FAQs, and primary CTA.

product_launch.name: Review landing page copy
product_launch.description: Collect stakeholder feedback and resolve copy edits before design starts.

product_launch.name: Design landing page
product_launch.description: Create desktop and mobile designs for the campaign landing page.

product_launch.name: Build landing page
product_launch.description: Build, connect forms, add tracking, and prepare QA checklist.

product_launch.name: Draft launch email
product_launch.description: Write launch email copy with subject line options and CTA.

product_launch.name: Build launch email
product_launch.description: Load the approved email into the email platform and confirm links.

product_launch.name: Create social launch posts
product_launch.description: Draft launch posts and supporting variations for selected social channels.

product_launch.name: Design social assets
product_launch.description: Create channel-ready graphics and thumbnails for social launch posts.

product_launch.name: Create paid ad variants
product_launch.description: Draft ad copy variants and map each to target audience and offer angle.

product_launch.name: Build paid campaigns
product_launch.description: Set targeting, budgets, creative, URLs, and conversion tracking.

product_launch.name: QA launch assets
product_launch.description: Check landing page, forms, emails, URLs, UTMs, ads, and mobile rendering.

product_launch.name: Final launch approval
product_launch.description: Confirm go/no-go with stakeholders after QA fixes are complete.

product_launch.name: Launch campaign
product_launch.description: Publish campaign assets and verify tracking after launch.

product_launch.name: Post-launch performance check
product_launch.description: Review early data, conversion paths, and urgent optimization needs.

product_launch.name: First optimization pass
product_launch.description: Adjust copy, budgets, creative, or audience settings based on early results.

webinar.name: Finalize webinar brief
webinar.description: Confirm topic, audience, speakers, CTA, registration goal, and follow-up offer.

webinar.name: Confirm speaker details
webinar.description: Collect speaker bios, headshots, talking points, and availability.

webinar.name: Write registration page copy
webinar.description: Draft webinar title, abstract, speaker section, and registration CTA.

webinar.name: Build registration page
webinar.description: Create page, connect form, confirmation message, and tracking.

webinar.name: Create promotional email sequence
webinar.description: Draft invite, reminder, last-chance, and post-event follow-up emails.

webinar.name: Build promotional emails
webinar.description: Load emails, test links, and schedule sends.

webinar.name: Create social promo posts
webinar.description: Draft social posts for announcement, reminders, and final call.

webinar.name: Design promo assets
webinar.description: Create speaker graphic, event banner, and social assets.

webinar.name: Set up webinar platform
webinar.description: Configure event, registration integration, reminders, recording, and attendee settings.

webinar.name: Run technical rehearsal
webinar.description: Confirm speaker audio, slides, screen share, recording, and event flow.

webinar.name: Final promotion check
webinar.description: Review registrations, scheduled sends, social posts, and paid support.

webinar.name: Host webinar
webinar.description: Run the live event and capture recording assets.

webinar.name: Send follow-up email
webinar.description: Send recording, offer, and next-step CTA to attendees and no-shows.

webinar.name: Publish webinar recap
webinar.description: Create a recap post or short summary asset from the webinar.

webinar.name: Report webinar performance
webinar.description: Summarize registrations, attendance, engagement, conversions, and next actions.

email_campaign.name: Finalize email campaign brief
email_campaign.description: Confirm audience, offer, segment, CTA, timing, and success metrics.

email_campaign.name: Draft email copy
email_campaign.description: Write email body, subject line options, preview text, and CTA.

email_campaign.name: Review email copy
email_campaign.description: Collect edits, confirm offer details, and approve final copy.

email_campaign.name: Build email
email_campaign.description: Load email into the platform, add links, UTMs, personalization, and tracking.

email_campaign.name: QA email
email_campaign.description: Send test emails, check rendering, proof links, and validate list rules.

email_campaign.name: Schedule email
email_campaign.description: Schedule the approved send and confirm suppression/exclusion rules.

email_campaign.name: Send email
email_campaign.description: Send or monitor the scheduled campaign.

email_campaign.name: Review email performance
email_campaign.description: Check opens, clicks, conversions, unsubscribes, and recommended follow-up.

paid_ads_campaign.name: Finalize paid campaign brief
paid_ads_campaign.description: Confirm offer, objective, target audience, budget, channels, and conversion goal.

paid_ads_campaign.name: Confirm tracking plan
paid_ads_campaign.description: Define UTMs, conversion events, pixels, and reporting views.

paid_ads_campaign.name: Draft ad copy variants
paid_ads_campaign.description: Create headline, body, description, and CTA variants by audience angle.

paid_ads_campaign.name: Design ad creative
paid_ads_campaign.description: Create ad graphics or video cutdowns for selected placements.

paid_ads_campaign.name: Review ads
paid_ads_campaign.description: Approve copy, creative, claims, landing page, and budget before buildout.

paid_ads_campaign.name: Build campaign in ad platforms
paid_ads_campaign.description: Set campaign structure, audience, placements, budgets, creative, and URLs.

paid_ads_campaign.name: QA campaign setup
paid_ads_campaign.description: Check URLs, tracking, budget pacing, audience exclusions, and creative previews.

paid_ads_campaign.name: Launch paid campaign
paid_ads_campaign.description: Publish ads and verify delivery, tracking, and spend.

paid_ads_campaign.name: First performance review
paid_ads_campaign.description: Review spend, CTR, CPC, conversions, and initial optimization needs.

paid_ads_campaign.name: Optimize campaign
paid_ads_campaign.description: Adjust budget, bids, audiences, creative, and low-performing variants.

content_campaign.name: Finalize content campaign brief
content_campaign.description: Confirm theme, audience, channels, primary CTA, and publishing cadence.

content_campaign.name: Create content outline
content_campaign.description: Draft structure, key points, proof, and distribution hooks.

content_campaign.name: Draft core content asset
content_campaign.description: Write the main article, guide, newsletter, or campaign asset.

content_campaign.name: Review core content asset
content_campaign.description: Collect edits and approve the asset before design or publishing.

content_campaign.name: Create supporting visuals
content_campaign.description: Design graphics, thumbnails, charts, or downloadable assets as needed.

content_campaign.name: Repurpose into channel posts
content_campaign.description: Create social, newsletter, and short-form versions from the core asset.

content_campaign.name: Prepare publishing setup
content_campaign.description: Load content, format page, check links, add UTMs, and prepare metadata.

content_campaign.name: QA publishing setup
content_campaign.description: Review formatting, links, mobile view, metadata, and tracking.

content_campaign.name: Publish content campaign
content_campaign.description: Publish the content and distribute through selected channels.

content_campaign.name: Review content performance
content_campaign.description: Check traffic, engagement, conversions, and recommended repromotion opportunities.
